name: stemgen
architecture: causal band-local/global recurrent complex-mask separator (StemgenRT 'causal-band-local-global-v1', descended from lucidrains' HS-TasNet); vocals sub-model only, cut out of the 3-model release asset by scripts/fetch_stemgen.py and verified bit-identical to the full graph
output_alignment: previous input hop; first return is an invalid pre-roll hop (discarded by processors/stemgen.py)
license: MIT (sweetspotsoundsystem/stemgen-rt — verified 2026-10-18; the ONNX file is a release asset of the MIT repo, no separate weights license). CAVEAT: trained on MUSDB18-HQ ('educational, non-commercial') and MoisesDB (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Not bundled into the .deb until that is decided.
notes: The first separator in this registry that is causal and block-synchronous: it fits the ~50 ms live path, unlike Spleeter (>=1.1 s). Upstream marks v0.7.0 quality_measured=False; v0.6.2 scored 5.45 dB vocals SDR on the maintainers' own panel. Measured here on one nasheed clip (Alhamdulillah, a100): SDR vs reference vocals 9.49 dB against 2.10 dB for the untouched mix, output lag 0 samples. Like every vocals-stem separator it drops sound effects along with the music. Spoken dialogue untested.
